image_description: A festive outdoor scene featuring a tall wooden maypole decorated with a floral wreath at the top. Numerous colorful ribbons (red, blue, yellow, white) extend from the top to the ground where a crowd of people in period-style clothing are holding them, seemingly engaged in a traditional dance. The background consists of dense green trees.

While the wreath is present, the exact physical connection points of individual ribbons to the pole/wreath are somewhat ambiguous and blurred, making the physics of the attachment unclear.
